methodology: The ranked list contains only results measured on the RTX 4070 12 GB node above under performance CPU governor. Historical fields not captured in the same run are shown as not recorded instead of being inferred. Community hardware stays in a separate, unranked dataset. findings.title: Alder Lake P-Core vs E-Core Pinning
findings.detail: GPU-offloaded LLM profiles pin to P-core logical CPUs `0-11` (`taskset -c 0-11`). Recruiting E-cores `12-15` into Strata's worker pool (`--aux-cpus auto` / `0-15`) regressed decode by -9.8 t/s due to barrier latency. On Inkling 2 Mini, `-t 12` (44.1 t/s) beat physical-only `-t 6` (38.1 t/s). E-cores `12-15` are reserved for non-exclusive co-resident utilities (`embeddinggemma-2`).

findings.title: DDR5-4800 JEDEC 2DPC Floor (60.0 GB/s)
findings.detail: Live `inxi -m` confirmed 4x16 GiB DDR5 running at 4800 MT/s (2DPC), matching the measured 60.0 GB/s 12-thread CPU read ceiling. Every offloaded MoE miss hits this floor, which is why raising GPU expert cache hit rate (STRATA_HC_Q8=1, --vram-pool, STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH=1) yields outsized decode gains.

findings.title: CPU Governor & Zram Swappiness Hygiene
findings.detail: Benchmarks gate on `cpupower.service` (`performance` governor); `powersave` throttles DDR5 bus switches and collapses decode from 12.2 to 6.5 t/s. Live audit flagged CachyOS default `vm.swappiness=150` paging 6.6 GiB into zram while 37 GiB RAM sat free; tuning `vm.swappiness=10` keeps hot host experts out of zram.

findings.title: NVMe PLE Stream & Page-Cache Isolation
findings.detail: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's 54.4 GB Q8_0 PLE table stays on NVMe (`--ple-io direct` on Strata, `-ot per_layer_token_embd.weight=CPU` on llama.cpp). Never pass `--ple-io mmap` on Strata or `--mlock` on Qwen3.8: mmapping 30-54 GB of PLE evicts the 39.4 GB expert arena from RAM and triggers heavy SSD refaulting (`0.1756 MB/tok`).

progression.breakthrough: Initial baseline; CPU powersave governor throttled DDR5 clock and bus switches.
Governor set to performance + EPP performance; eliminated memory bus throttling (+88%).
51B PLE n-gram table offloaded to NVMe SSD via mmap; 3-tier memory model established.
--fit on --fit-target 512, q8_0 KV cache, tensor scheduling.
Fused GDN alpha/beta projections and RMSNorm kernels merged into upstream.
Compact 1.78 GB MTP head; first time breaking 20 t/s on 12 GB GPU.
PR #29599 NVMe row madvise prefetch (3x cold prefill boost) + PR #28770 sparse FA.
Online dynamic expert cache (3,086 GPU experts) + native MTP + 2MB THP.
Native upstream 2MB THP and #783 sub-warp IQ kernels; prefill reaches ~2,000 t/s @ 8k.
Verified performance governor run: 62.2 t/s steady (90.2 peak), 75-78% cache hit rate.
Pruned 172k LOC non-Ada bloat; cherry-picked Ada sm_89 MMVQ interleave tables (+4.52 t/s) and --kv-grow.
Admitting PCIe-streamed misses into GPU cache lifted steady decode +26.6% (55.6 -> 70.4 t/s) and hit rate to 67.2%; CPU share boosted pp2k +18.8%.
Quantizing hyper-connections to Q8_0 freed 0.39 GiB VRAM for +238 GPU expert slots (2,949 total, 72.4% hit rate); LEND_PCT=40 unlocked 2.87 GiB --kv-grow headroom.
